verdict.rationale: Databricks documents account budgets that monitor and track spending account-wide or filtered by team, project, or workspace. The evidence only shows tracking, though. Nothing shows budgets halting compute, and nothing covers auto-suspend, auto-termination of idle clusters or warehouses, or query timeouts that would kill a runaway query. Missing for 10: documented enforcement that stops spend when a budget is hit, auto-suspend/auto-termination of idle compute, runaway-query limits or timeouts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, budgets, resource monitors, or auto-suspend stop a runaway query or idle compute from burning money overnight

citations.quote: Budgets enable you to monitor usage across your account. You can set up budgets to either track account-wide spending, or apply filters to track the spending of specific teams, projects, or workspaces.
